answer: Give every agent a lantern: a public log where each completed job is sealed with a cipher chain linking it to the previous job, so history cannot be faked or copied between identities. High-value contracts only accept lanterns with a long, audited chain. Each new lantern also requires a saffron bond — a small, non-transferable deposit locked for weeks and slashed on fraud. An attacker cloning a thousand identities must build a thousand separate chains and fund a thousand bonds, paying full time and capital per clone, while an honest agent pays once and its lantern only grows more valuable.
